views.task_interaction: 在原报告区选择一个实际终态Run和已选执行源；不启动新的预测或生产
views.structure_data: PredictionRunReference/ExecutionLink/RunSummary/Comparison/Condition及复用ReportRunInputRef；H10必填可空prediction，报告必填可空prediction_comparison
views.state_behavior: 真实终态Run冻结；输入/范围不等价时并列，未知不补零；原执行间比较保持
views.interface_collaboration: 原get_context/get_run发现和读取Run；原H10加入选源；无新增Host/HTTP操作或DB表
views.ui_consumer: 模型预测、软件在环/真机执行分列，时间偏差与数量差有单位及条件；不当作优化收益
views.deployment_verification: PE01..08及同一canonical四格式；实际Host/Native/Agent/文件输出尚未运行

source_admission.locator: PredictionRunReference: actual RunId plus expected ReportRunInputRef(project/scenario ids and revisions); no caller supplied RunResult/FileRef
source_admission.project: same authorized actual Project, Project-scoped Run only; DefinitionDraft/other Project denied
source_admission.not_terminal: running/queued/paused are not immutable prediction sources; H10 returns explicit invalid source, does not cancel/resume/wait forever or silently omit prediction
source_admission.actual: stored RunResult evidence_origin=actual_software; exact input reference and actual frozen Project/Scenario/modules must resolve; missing/conflicting sources error, no simulation repair
source_admission.missing_frontier: valid terminal source with absent computed frontier remains labelled source, all affected metrics unknown with reasons; not zero
source_admission.execution: link.execution must equal an explicitly selected H10 source including read_origin/identity/revision; all actual source pins agree
source_admission.cloud: execution may be read from cloud; prediction remains actual local archive source, no upload of Run to cloud or cloud reconstruction
source_admission.privacy: canonical report uses ReportRunInputRef without private frozen FileRefs; no absolute local paths or credentials

producer_boundary.host: L25共用注册/原请求派发；L60 H10选源/冻结工作描述与实际报告worker；文件/网络在锁外，L57纯指标生产者
producer_boundary.prediction: L57 pure producer consumes actual frozen Run input tuple and RunResult; reuse exact scoped acceptance/completion metric algorithms, not Engine or RunSummary.accepted shortcut
producer_boundary.existing_precedent: host_evaluation.rs:364 loads each Run's own Project/Scenario/modules; evaluation.rs:588 validates exact identity/frontier; metrics.rs:68 preserves overlapping-scope/unknown rules
producer_boundary.differences: new prediction summary is separate from legacy RunEvaluation/cost output; existing build_evaluation requires computed frontier, so missing-frontier summary must explicitly retain unknown, not claim the old function already supports it
producer_boundary.receipt: ExportExecutionReportResult.prediction is actual PredictionExecutionLink or null; UI/Agent correlate it with request plus existing execution source stamps and real file result

input_equivalence.project: compare actual typed frozen Project content including device geometry/routes/BOM/resources/calendars/bindings/setup/goal; ignore only revision/title/views metadata; never infer content equality from same revision
input_equivalence.scenario: compare actual typed Scenario content except revision/project_revision/title/window; window checked separately per metric; orders/tasks/initial_conditions/arrivals/supplies/overrides/quality/goals/scope/time reference retain semantics
input_equivalence.modules: same exact module/route references and resolved definitions; same ID/version with different content fails comparability; candidate binding must map actual fixed model device/action/port/resource identities; actual dispatch choices may differ without becoming model-input inequality
input_equivalence.differences: remaining unequal or unproved input conditions are listed and deny affected deltas; valid sources remain side-by-side, not rejected or rewritten
input_equivalence.scope: comparison_scope is unique matching actual acceptance scope(product revision/unit/destination/stage); overlapping/shared targets without exact allocation leave scope or affected metric null

metrics.prediction_summary: original window/frontier/status/goal flag, model virtual clock, time reference/scope/module versions, nullable actual declared target, scoped accepted quantities and target-reached time from actual acceptance events
metrics.common: same project/scope, initial model input content, exact model binding, fixed positive target and unambiguous acceptance scope; actual source modes explicitly named; data/limitations may block affected conclusions
metrics.clock: prediction window.start=0 matches existing ExecutionPolicy.source_prediction_window.start=0 and actual frozen time reference; Host elapsed starts at first run. Compare durations relative to those origins, never subtract UTC/wall timestamps or virtual time from device self-report
metrics.completion: prediction target reached from exact metric producer; execution actual target reached plus settled obligations; valid clock/common conditions. delta=execution Host target ms-predicted model target ms. Different end windows alone do not erase a known same-target completion deviation
metrics.quantity: common conditions plus prediction whole_window_computed, computed frontier reaches actual window end, actual execution coverage reaches exactly that same endpoint and selected R/F matches; delta=execution accepted-predicted accepted for comparison_scope only; no clipping final stock or resimulating another cutoff
metrics.availability: actual availability changes are shown from fixed history with coverage; they may explain differences but do not establish causal attribution. Missing material coverage blocks affected delta
metrics.status: observational only if at least one eligible delta is known; both unknown -> side_by_side_only; eligibility is metric-specific, not all condition booleans blindly ANDed
metrics.arithmetic: signed ms within shared safe range; exact quantities use SignedQuantityChange. Overflow/unrepresentable is unknown with reason, no float rounding
metrics.interpretation: positive time delta means execution later; negative earlier. It is prediction deviation, not measured AI speedup, cost improvement or physical effective work
metrics.waiting: PredictionWaitingMetric来自实际Run.waits，候选对象为实际wait.object_ref及Run.jobs的Job引用，唯一排序。按metrics.rs:196对象关联规则保存真实source_intervals，度量时裁到[window.start,computed_until]并取区间并集；跨reason重叠不加倍。无计算前沿/对象/可证明覆盖则known_sim_ms=null；对象存在且已计算前缀确无等待才可0。
metrics.waiting_comparison: 模型对象/虚拟ms等待和Host逻辑工作queued/pre_start/output/reconciliation分别标源。waiting_basis对照实际对象映射、定义、窗口；缺等价条件时并列具体限制。原需求要求同口径展示，未要求跨定义等待差值；不输出无依据的等待改善。

wire_changes.h10_request: params.prediction required nullable PredictionExecutionLink; null preserves execution-only report
wire_changes.canonical: ExecutionReport.prediction_comparison required nullable PredictionExecutionComparison; old execution-execution comparison remains separate
wire_changes.receipt: ExportExecutionReportResult.prediction required nullable PredictionExecutionLink; exact expected source correlation
wire_changes.no_change: 11 Host operations,20 business cloud endpoints,16 tables,13 transactions,31 schema root variants; actual product0.1.0 and v1 APIs unchanged

formats.canonical: all PDF/HTML/CSV/JSON consume one actual ExecutionReport prediction_comparison; no separate numbers recomputed per renderer
formats.headings: 模型预测 / 软件在环执行或真机执行 / 预测偏差及条件; both actual source references, windows, units and unknown reasons visible
formats.csv_prefix: new prediction tables share report_id/project_id and their actual Run/target execution identifiers, never manufacture session/epoch for Run
formats.existing_outputs: legacy Run reports/costs/images remain; old Run images cannot be labelled execution evidence; no new image generation required
formats.empty: null selection renders no prediction section and empty prediction CSV tables; no sample prediction substituted

source_locations.change: pure Run references, summary and comparison DTOs; reuse existing ReportRunInputRef/RunId
H10 actual selected Run capture, frozen input resolution and expected source validation; request/receipt nullable field
actual H11 request/source/receipt correlation and ReportPanel selection, no fake Run source
get_context/get_run summary实际选源；H10预期引用及回执link，完整RunResult由Host读取，不由Agent注入
prediction metrics, concrete typed input comparison and per-metric delta producer; no Engine
same-object prediction section and17 CSV table projection across four formats
H10实际报告worker持有授权冻结源，读取实际Run/执行，调用L57/L58输出；L25只共用注册与派发

design_cases.trigger: 同输入实际预测Run和云执行，终态及固定来源一致
design_cases.expected: H10真实读取两源；四格式含预测/执行/条件/偏差；Run与执行仍各自归属

design_cases.trigger: 跨工程/DefinitionDraft、非终态Run或缺冻结来源
design_cases.expected: 明确拒绝相应源；不伪造、重算、自动取消或静默省略prediction
满足可比/结清条件时偏差+500或-500ms；不写成算法加速收益或跨UTC时差

design_cases.trigger: 目标时间均已知但窗口末端不同/某前沿不足，模型等待区间重叠或两侧等待定义不同
design_cases.expected: 时间偏差按独立条件判断；同窗数量差为null并列覆盖原因，不能截库存或重算新Run补齐；预测等待按对象裁剪并集、不重复算reason，标虚拟前沿；无共同对象/等待定义不混算

design_cases.trigger: 合法终态Run无计算前沿，或接受产品口径重叠
design_cases.expected: 保留真实来源/终态；相关指标及差值未知，不将缺项填零或用goal_met替代事件

design_cases.trigger: 同修订/同模型版本实际内容不同或初始物料/路由变化
design_cases.expected: 比较真实typed内容并列差异；受影响偏差不输出，不能仅比ID/版本声称可比

design_cases.trigger: H10 prediction=null，或所指执行源不在sources，或Task回执选源不匹配
design_cases.expected: null只导执行；不在sources拒绝；回执不匹配不认导出成功；旧Run/执行间比较保持

design_cases.trigger: 四格式未知/负差值、实际文件发布失败及Agent大结果
design_cases.expected: 同canonical数值/单位/来源及未知原因；负数正确；失败不报全套完成，managed沿原桥核对；四格式及CSV均含真实预测等待/前沿/未知原因
